structured.answer: I'd open the account at Psagot, the one marked "הזול", and buy the fund that was already filled in, "אי.בי.אי. מחקה ת"א 125 (4A)". The page says I'd have about 86,045 ₪ after 10 years (10,000 to start and 500 a month). I'd ask my son about the fund before buying.

stuck.why: The minus sign "−1,030" made me back away. I wasn't sure what it meant.
"מחקה" and "(4A)" mean nothing to me, so I'm not sure I'm buying the right thing.
Every row repeats the same "לא בחישוב" text. It wore me out and I nearly stopped.
